_: Lane -> model, per harness. Data, not code: retiering a lane or repricing a model is an edit here and nothing else. Lane selection itself belongs to the caller; this file only says which model serves a chosen lane.

L0.why: Frontier deliberation. Explicitly authorized work whose main cost is thinking: a foundational design decision or deep option synthesis. Never inferred from difficulty, ambiguity or scope.

L1.why: Complex reasoning. Bounded but difficult or high-consequence engineering: architecture, diagnosis, review, security, irreversible or service-wide change.

L2.why: Everyday engineering. The default lane when nothing selects another.

L3.why: Mechanical work whose shape is already decided and whose result a compiler or a test catches.
